name: Site, Room, Rack, Network Element, Components
foundation_dependencies: LLD-01 UnitOfWork/idempotency/audit/STRICT schema/job conventions and DataInstanceIdentityReader
LLD-02 Customer Organization and Dispatch Location identities plus Site↔Dispatch ownership reservation
LLD-03 Device Reference operational identity/resolution boundary
LLD-07 Device Part Unit identity, InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader and optional Installed Component resolution interface
future LLD-10 UI working-copy/three-second deliberate-hold interaction
future LLD-12 authentication/DeliberateActionProof and release dependency pinning
scope: Site physical Datacenter identity and stable Customer ownership
one-to-one Site↔dedicated Dispatch Location relationship and site-derived address provider
Room/Rack identity and physical placement/occupancy history
Device Reference→Network Element regularization without operational identity replacement
Cloud Type and Site-scoped Cloud Deployment assignment
descriptive zero-many IP inventory with at-most-one primary
reusable Network Element Model/BOM/component compatibility knowledge
Installed Component instance identity/history under Network Element
Device Part Unit→Installed Component optional resolution
versioned macro-free Infrastructure workbook generation, discovery, staging, review and atomic acceptance
not_owned_here: Customer Organization and Dispatch Location master lifecycle -> LLD-02
Inventory Device Part Unit/physical consequence/return lifecycle -> LLD-07
transaction_boundaries: Standalone Infrastructure mutations use one LLD-01 UnitOfWork and insert the single command_receipt before any receipt-FK child/event/projection row; reducers/repositories never create nested receipts or commits.

CreateSite coordinates LLD-02 dedicated Dispatch Location creation plus Site and one-to-one link inside the same outer UnitOfWork; any participant failure rolls back all three identities/relationships.

Device Reference regularization verifies required session-bound deliberate-action proof before mutation, then creates/links only through LLD-08 in one outer UnitOfWork and never retargets LLD-03/05/07 operational relationships.
Maintenance-derived Installed Component changes consume LLD-07 InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader for current evidence validation; LLD-08 has no Inventory or Task writer.

Workbook parsing/staging/proposal calculation and XLSX writing occur outside long writer transactions. Accepted selected workbook mutations revalidate through the same manual domain services in one all-or-nothing outer UnitOfWork; staging cleanup is post-terminal technical minimization only.
failure_modes: stale revisions/fingerprints, same-Site violations, Rack occupancy conflicts, primary-IP races, containment cycles, component slot conflicts and archived/master changes fail before commit and preserve prior state
archive/dependency or Inventory-consequence INDETERMINATE results fail closed
any required cross-domain participant, audit/result, projection or replay-index failure rolls back the owning authoritative UnitOfWork
unsafe/locked/corrupt/unsupported workbook input produces bounded failure evidence without source modification or domain mutation
crash after an accepted workbook commit but before technical staging cleanup leaves valid authoritative state and retryable cleanup rather than an incomplete domain transaction

acceptance_tests.execution_status: design_explicit_not_yet_executed; automation/execution required before implementation-ready and final owner acceptance

design_principle: Infrastructure registers physical truth without replacing operational identities. Site placement, containment, Cloud assignment, descriptive IPs, reusable compatibility knowledge, installed Component history and workbook evidence remain independent relationship authorities; none may silently imply connectivity, identity equality or another domain lifecycle fact.
